normalize_gtest_json_output: normalize Google Test JSON output by replacing transient time, timestamp, and stack trace values with wildcards
normalize_test_failure_messages: normalize test failure messages by masking file line numbers and stack traces in GTest JSON output
normalize_time_fields: normalize time fields in GTest JSON output by replacing duration strings like 1.23s with wildcards
normalize_timestamp_fields: normalize timestamp fields in GTest JSON output by replacing ISO 8601 timestamps with wildcards
normalize_nested_json_objects: normalize nested dictionaries and lists in GTest JSON output by recursively applying normalization rules
